count is one number per option, so twenty minions, four pillars, four plates and three keys compete for one field on the options they share. Numbers only survive by being repeated in the text.
One prompt, four maps, one scale band. A citadel lobby and a laser room are not the same band and there is one field for both.
station-training was the nearest row for the damage-test dummy and was rejected: it exists to raise a stat, which this dummy does not.

notes: Route override applied: world-biomes normally carries P4, but the prompt says 'large seamless open world', which the shape-versus-prompt rule treats as an explicit statement for one continuous map. Built P0 with the biome variety on one surface.
terrain-relief is P2 rather than P0+tiered here because the prompt asks for caves and ice tunnels, which overhang.

Extent and detail cannot both be honoured: a seamless continental world and a shelter interior you furnish are two frames' worth of information. Recommend the shelter and its surroundings at full detail now, with the far regions as separate maps later.
No level gate was placed on the distant regions. Danger in this style is a gradient — colder, farther, scarcer — and a physical blockade would be wrong for it.

Simulation was considered as a second genre for the build-and-upgrade loop and left off: Survival's resource preset already carries the plot and the nodes, and RPG's notes warn the two bundles are near-duplicates.

notes_for_us: The seamless-world override worked exactly as written — the prompt says 'large seamless open world' and the rule turned world-biomes from P4 into P0 without ambiguity. Worth keeping as a case where an explicit statement beat a shape default cleanly.

There is no way to express a difficulty or richness gradient, which is this design's core spatial idea: common materials near base, rare loot and worse storms further out. That is a property of distance across the map, and the only tools available are per-option text and a fence-style gate the genre notes correctly forbid.

Weather is load-bearing here rather than decoration — the whole temperature loop is driven by blizzards and nightfall, and shelter spacing depends on how often a storm catches you out. Nothing in the handoff carries weather, time of day or auroras.

Extent and detail genuinely conflict on this prompt and the skill told me to say so and offer the split, which is the right instruction; but the deferral only lands in notes, so the handoff still claims one map at region scale with furnished interiors in it.

notes_for_us: The touch-to-become-a-character morph has no option anywhere, and it is the whole game in this family — one of the largest categories on Roblox. collectible-nodes places the thing but reads as a pickup, not as a transformation trigger.

This prompt is a genuine theme null: it names no place, no setting and no reference game. Everything the enrichment added visually was invented, which is the right outcome for the skill and the wrong outcome for the build, so it argues the theme question is the highest-value one here rather than the last.

'Each would have advantages and disadvantages' sounds like a layout ask — different movement abilities imply reachable and unreachable ground — but nothing in the handoff can say 'this ledge is only reachable as the jumping character'.
